directions.label: Light English optimist
directions.prompt: Create a voice for an enthusiastic puppy chess companion. An adult man in his early twenties, speaking naturally in a light clear upper register with a contemporary southern English accent. Fresh, agile and friendly rather than a mature narrator or teacher. Smooth youthful adult resonance with very little chest heaviness; relaxed quick reactions, bright curiosity and an easy smile that settles into clear advice. Natural adult speech, never a child imitation, theatrical falsetto or cartoon squeak. No gravel or booming authority. Fluent English at a normal conversational pace, about eight to ten seconds. Clear words and a fully finished final phrase. Clean dry studio sound, one voice, no music or animal noises. An original fictional adult voice, never an imitation of a named actor or character.

directions.label: Bright American friend
directions.prompt: Design an original puppy chess companion voice. An adult woman in her early twenties with an American accent and a light, bright, naturally high speaking register. Fresh-faced energetic teammate delivery, animated curiosity and quick delighted reactions, then a sincere practical explanation. Crisp lively consonants and a little airy texture without whispering. Friendly conversational adult speech, not a polished older presenter, not baby talk or a child impression, and not squeaky cartoon acting. Fluent English at a normal conversational pace, about eight to ten seconds. Clear words and a fully finished final phrase. Clean dry studio sound, one voice, no music or animal noises. An original fictional adult voice, never an imitation of a named actor or character.

directions.label: Gentle Kiwi companion
directions.prompt: Create a friendly puppy chess companion voice. A young adult man in his twenties with a recognizable New Zealand English accent. A slim, soft, clear tenor speaking voice, smooth and lightly airy, with warm easygoing curiosity. Quiet enthusiasm and a spontaneous delighted smile rather than authoritative teaching. Connected relaxed phrases and natural adult resonance, noticeably gentler than an excitable cartoon sidekick. No gravelly bass, mature narrator weight, child imitation or forced falsetto. Fluent English at a normal conversational pace, about eight to ten seconds. Clear words and a fully finished final phrase. Clean dry studio sound, one voice, no music or animal noises. An original fictional adult voice, never an imitation of a named actor or character.
